brief:
A former U.S. diplomat has called for preventing officials involved in Biden administration Gaza policy from holding office again, the Quincy Institute reported. The statement reflects deepening criticism within diplomatic circles over the administration's handling of the Israel-Gaza conflict and its human toll.

The demand signals growing pressure on how decision-makers will be held accountable for Gaza-related policy choices. No timeline or mechanism for such accountability was detailed in the report.
title: Ex-diplomat calls for barring Biden Gaza officials from future power
